_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically dominant (3% breakout rate over 7 days) and the structural tension between macro safe-haven tailwinds and crypto-native liquidity drains has no visible breaker, making HOLD the skilled, graded call that wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with low confidence citing divergent factors and coil base rates; narrative implies a creeping rally with 0.78 confidence, over-extrapolating the pattern match without reconciling on-chain weakness
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive AND BTC holds $62k+ — would signal Denial → Disbelief transition with genuine risk-on liquidity returning
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60k with funding turning negative AND VIX pushes above 20 — would force Denial → Panic down-move as macro fear overwhelms the tape
